name: Atukuri Molla
bio: Atukuri Molla (Mollamamba) is the best-known woman poet of classical Telugu literature. She was the daughter of Atukuri Kesana Setti, a potter of the Gopavaram area in present-day Andhra Pradesh, and she gives her father's name and her own at the close of each section of her poem.

Her Molla Ramayanamu is a retelling of the Ramayana in Telugu verse, composed in plain, unlearned diction and famous for its brevity beside the longer Telugu versions. Tradition places her in the sixteenth century, though the date is uncertain; the archive follows the editor's broad dating.
